<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/credit_grants/{grant}/activity"}
#docs
A draw by usage paid in credits names its settlement and meter; a draw on an invoice names the invoice. Needs `credits:view`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | The customer's id (cus_…). |
| `grant` | `string` | **yes** | The credit grant's id (cgr_…). |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Page size, 1 to 1000. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `credit_grant_activity`. One of `credit_grant_activity`. |
| `grant` | `string` | cgr_… |
| `customer` | `string` | cus_… |
| `unit` | `string` | The credit unit; null for money. |
| `currency` | `string` | ISO 4217. |
| `category` | `string` | The credit grant activity's category. One of `paid`, `promotional`. |
| `purchased_units` | `integer` | Units the grant gave, in the smallest step. |
| `purchased_units_decimal` | `string` | The same, in whole units. |
| `status` | `string` | The grant's status: pending, active, expired or voided. |
| `cost_basis_minor` | `integer` | What the buyer paid. 0 for given credit. |
| `used_units` | `integer` | Units used, less draws given back. |
| `used_units_decimal` | `string` | The same, in whole units. |
| `revenue_recognised_minor` | `integer` | Revenue booked as the paid credit was used. |
| `expired_units` | `integer` | Units that expired. |
| `expired_units_decimal` | `string` | The same, in whole units. |
| `breakage_minor` | `integer` | Cost of the paid units that expired. |
| `voided_units` | `integer` | Units voided. |
| `voided_units_decimal` | `string` | The same, in whole units. |
| `refunded_minor` | `integer` | Cost of the paid units voided by a credit note. |
| `credited_minor` | `integer` | What credit notes gave back on the pack line that sold this grant. A full refund includes the used credits. |
| `rolled_over_units` | `integer` | Net units moved in or out by a rollover. |
| `remaining_units` | `integer` | Units left. |
| `remaining_units_decimal` | `string` | The same, in whole units. |
| `remaining_cost_minor` | `integer` | Cost of the units left: deferred revenue. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The movement id. |
| `data.kind` | `string` | The credit grant activity's kind. One of `grant`, `activate`, `draw`, `restore`, `expire`, `void`, `rollover_in`, `rollover_out`. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit grant activity was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.units` | `integer` | Signed, in the smallest step. |
| `data.units_decimal` | `string` | Signed, in whole units. |
| `data.cost_minor` | `integer` | Signed cost of these units. |
| `data.invoice` | `string` | in_… for an invoice draw, a purchase or a credit note void. |
| `data.invoice_number` | `string` | That invoice's number, once it has one. |
| `data.settlement` | `string` | cst_… for a draw by usage paid in credits. |
| `data.meter` | `string` | The meter of that settlement. |
| `data.meter_name` | `string` | That meter's name. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Pass as `starting_after` to get the next page. Null on the last page. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The grant's activity. |
| `404` | No such customer or credit grant. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/credit_grants/cgr_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/activity?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
